raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The payments-source feed renamed status POSTED to SETTLED on 2026-01-16, and the change note says the meaning is unchanged. Batches 12-14 therefore contain only SETTLED (and REVERSED) rows, so the `status = 'POSTED'` filter drops them all. Including SETTLED alongside POSTED, and still excluding REVERSED, restores the intended silver population without duplicates, since txn_id is unique.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
